The '''Axxila system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[D'Astan sector/Legends|D'Astan sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

The Axxila system was known as a notable [[Spice/Legends|spice]]-[[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] system.<ref name="TEA" />
